WITH f AS (
  SELECT fl.market_ticker AS t, split_part(fl.market_ticker,'-',1) AS ser, lower(fl.side) AS side,
         fl.price::numeric AS px, coalesce(fl.quantity,0)::numeric AS q, coalesce(fl.fee,0)::numeric AS fee
  FROM fills fl JOIN live_orders lo ON lo.kalshi_order_id = fl.kalshi_order_id
  WHERE lo.strategy ILIKE '%mmsell%' AND fl.filled_at >= '2026-07-01'),
tk AS (SELECT DISTINCT t FROM f),
r AS (
  SELECT pt.market_ticker AS t,
         max(CASE WHEN pt.resolved_value=100 THEN lower(pt.side) WHEN pt.resolved_value=0 THEN CASE WHEN lower(pt.side)='yes' THEN 'no' ELSE 'yes' END END) AS res
  FROM paper_trades pt JOIN tk ON tk.t = pt.market_ticker
  WHERE pt.status='settled' AND pt.resolved_value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1),
m AS (
  SELECT f.t, f.ser, f.side, r.res, sum(q) AS q, sum(px*q) AS cost, sum(fee) AS fee
  FROM f LEFT JOIN r ON r.t=f.t GROUP BY 1,2,3,4),
mp AS (SELECT *, (CASE WHEN res=side THEN 100*q ELSE 0 END - cost)/100.0 - fee AS pnl FROM m WHERE res IS NOT NULL),
s AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN ser LIKE 'KXMLB%' THEN ser ELSE 'non-MLB:' || CASE WHEN count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ser) >= 40 THEN ser ELSE 'other' END END AS cell, *
  FROM mp)
SELECT cell, count(*) AS mkts, sum(q) AS contracts,
       round(100 - sum(cost)/nullif(sum(q),0),2) AS be_pct,
       round(100*count(*) FILTER (WHERE res<>side)::numeric/count(*),2) AS loss_pct_mkts,
       round(100*count(*) FILTER (WHERE res<>side)::numeric/count(*) - (100 - sum(cost)/nullif(sum(q),0)),2) AS gap_pp,
       round(sum(pnl),2) AS net, round(100*sum(pnl)/nullif(sum(q),0),2) AS c_per_contract
FROM s GROUP BY ROLLUP(cell) ORDER BY net
